With the button hidden, the menu still opens from the toolbar button on a Canvas tab and from the search bar's 'Open BetterCampus'.

Dark mode with a light theme: Tb (span 94p8m062) makes the dark palette from the theme's light one by taking 40% off each color's HSL lightness and graying it, so a cream page turned mid khaki under near-black text and links, and a dark sidebar got lighter. Its dark palette now comes from src/bcx/darkPreset.ts (t = the theme's palette, e = their var() resolver), falling back to theirs if ours returns nothing. Every path that applies, previews or edits a theme goes through Tb.

Default dark palette (Pu; the stored-defaults copy has buttons: and doesn't match): softer text, #dedede and #d0d0d0 instead of near-white #f5f5f5 and #e2e2e2.
